# `gameplay/ai/NPCBrain.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/ai/NPCBrain.js`

NPCBrain — Tiny JavaScript brain for each NPC. Inputs feed drives. The strongest LEGAL drive wins (RuleGraph filters). Memory changes the weights over time. Drives: fight, flee, protect, steal, obey, betray, comfort, digBuild, follow, reportCrime
